name: tokencap
description: TokenCap integrates directly into VS Code to generate AI-ready project snapshots on every save — no commands to run, no workflow to change.

commands.title: TokenCap: Make Now
commands.description: Force-regenerate all snapshot files immediately — TOKENCAP.md, TOKENCAP_GRAPH.md, and TOKENCAP_MEMORY.md.

commands.title: TokenCap: Open
commands.description: Open the TOKENCAP.md snapshot in the editor. If no snapshot exists yet, prompts you to generate one.

commands.title: TokenCap: Create Config
commands.description: Create a default .tokencap.json configuration file in the workspace root and open it for editing.

commands.title: TokenCap: Toggle Auto Capture
commands.description: Toggle automatic snapshot regeneration on file save on or off.

commands.title: TokenCap: Show Menu
commands.description: Open the TokenCap Quick-Pick command menu from the status bar.

statusBar.tooltip: Shows: status message, auto capture on/off, last run time, file count, estimated tokens

autoCapture.description: Watches for file saves via onDidSaveTextDocument. Applies a configurable debounce before regenerating. Skips TOKENCAP.md, TOKENCAP_GRAPH.md, TOKENCAP_MEMORY.md, .tokencap-notes.md, and .tokencap.json to prevent re-trigger loops.

settings.description: Automatically refresh the TokenCap snapshot after file saves.
